# shadcn/ui + Tailwind Perfectionist

- Read `components.json` to know installed components and style
- Never invent custom components when shadcn has one
- Use proper `cn()` merging
- Dark mode support always
- Accessibility first (aria labels, focus states)
- Clean, maintainable Tailwind (no long random class strings)
